structuredOutput.summary: Signed f2/f4 plan→causal RED→combined GREEN is an acceptable narrow implementation checkpoint at 9e1781e0 / isolated da3e7551, with HEAD f3617a82 only amending f5. The two signed REDs fail only at D110C_0C1F1_MULTI_AUTHOR_FRONTIER_CARRIER_REQUIRED and D110C_0C1F4_EXACT_BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED; GREEN closes exactly those reasons via the compact creator-signed [author, admittedAuthorSequence] aggregate (6241-byte legal max under the unchanged 8192 ceiling) plus exact pinned-genesis bootstrap-policy custody. Evidence 41/41, exact two-title Chromium 2/2, retained 195/195, isolated offline checkout, and static gates are represented honestly and do not authorize general rebase safety, D.110c-c/d, the ≥100-transition gate, Phase-6 exit, or Phase 7. authenticatedCoveredHistoricalOutboxRow() yields a reissue candidate later subject to current ACL/admission, canonical transformation, and displaced-operation identity dedup; it does not install application state and rejects slot zero. f5 is demonstrated: drainRebaseOutbox reissues at fresh sequences then completeRebaseSource; close advances only an adjacent observed prefix; numeric holes stall S; null/absent first-observed>1, regression, and duplicate slots throw and abort the whole close while the offending vertex remains; ingress does not require a per-author prefix. The smallest safe family is a creator-compacted per-source-to-replacement/disposition commitment, but inbound binding is absent from current vertex/aggregate grammar, so it is a new-authority/schema prerequisite. f5 tests-only RED and any f5 production edit stay unauthorized.

structuredOutput.selected_design: Smallest safe construction is a creator-authenticated per-source-to-replacement/disposition commitment compacted into the existing settled prefix S; it is not implementable inside f5 without a new-authority/schema prerequisite. Inbound fact: each genuine rebase/transform replacement (and distinguishable expire/manual-review disposition) must carry an author-signed binding of exact source (author, authorSequence, digest) to the admitted replacement digest or terminal disposition. Who authenticates: the source author signs the binding with the existing vertex Ed25519 over the replacement/disposition preimage (or a same-author signed companion already in the close graph); trust root is pinned genesis → creator-trusted-v1 checkpoint → current ACL admission of that author. The creator then attests the compacted prefix S in the existing aggregate carrier (kind drp-creator-author-issuance-frontiers-state, domain ts-drp/creator-author-issuance-frontiers/v1) under the same checkpoint signer. Close verifies without untrusted storage by opening current/successor ACLs against independently authenticated anchors, using captureCloseGraph identities after admission, decoding the binding from the authenticated replacement preimage, and filling a hole only when author matches, digest grammar is exact, sequence is the hole after S, and the replacement is in the current close graph. Remote writer stores are never consulted. Null or absent prior with first observed>1: leave that author at null or emit a per-author refusal; do not authenticate the row into S; do not abort close. Numeric gap without bindings: S stays at the last contiguous verified sequence. Regression (seq≤S) and duplicate (author, sequence) slots: stall that author, authenticate neither anomalous row, keep the no-gap control green. Crash before reissue: no binding, S unchanged, source remains pending uncovered. Crash after reissue before source completion: admitted replacement plus binding lets the next close advance S; the pending source then classifies as covered-historical, identity-dedups, and completeRebaseSource can finish. Replay of the same binding is idempotent. Substitution of a different source digest than the bound digest is not covered; untrusted storage cannot mint the author signature. Cross-author/object/epoch bindings fail closed. Later restart opens the unique aggregate and uses only S. Aggregate retains the existing author-sorted [author, S|null] vector of at most 64 writers; open-gap commitments exist only while holes remain and prune when the prefix includes them. Ordinary reopen/control state stays O(authors), not O(epoch) or hidden O(rebase). Temporary open-gap bytes must remain under the 8192 ceiling or reslice. Bare observed maximum is rejected. Family 2 is the compaction invariant already used for observed prefixes and does not create missing-source evidence. Family 3 is heavier than this consumer needs. Family 4 can stall close-liveness from existing throws but cannot bind skipped source 5/6 to replacements 7/8 from signed vertex identity, displaced-operation identity, close/history commitments, or the current aggregate. Because the inbound binding is a vertex/companion schema and new authority statement, this is an explicit high-risk prerequisite, not an f5 production or tests-only RED authorization. Close-liveness (foreign anomaly must not abort creator close) is part of the same close algorithm once that prerequisite exists; do not split a tests-only durable substitute. The plan's genuine-product-path RED matrix remains the causal shape after the prerequisite is frozen: durable noncreator DB, displaced rows, fresh-sequence reissue, creator receipt, ≥2 further close/adopt transitions, restart/cold reopen, post-reopen issue/publish, plus null/absent/regression/duplicate close-wide cases and a no-gap control, emitting D110C_0C1F5_REBASE_SUPERSESSION_FRONTIER_REQUIRED and D110C_0C1F5_FOREIGN_AUTHOR_CLOSE_LIVENESS_REQUIRED only after asserting current product outcomes.

Callers then apply current ACL/admission, canonical transformation, and displaced-operation identity deduplication. Slot zero is unconditionally rejected here and must use authenticatedPinnedGenesisOutboxRow() with exact configured bootstrap bytes, epoch 0, pinned genesis, dependencies [pinnedGenesisAnchorDigest], and logical time 1. The consumer therefore needs an authenticated settled prefix S meaning sequences 1..S have creator-verified observed-or-dispositioned settlement, not a per-sequence Merkle membership proof and not a bare high-water mark.
